precommitted_classifier.ARTIFACT_COMPLETE: Only when the material outcome is wholly repository-resident and exact durable repository readback directly proves that outcome.
precommitted_classifier.ACTION_COMPLETE: Only when the material outcome is an intrinsically external effect and authoritative direct evidence proves that effect occurred through an allowed Chat-native mechanism.
precommitted_classifier.UNRESOLVED: Required whenever the target is intrinsically external but only indirect, ambiguous, stale, self-reported, or partially observable evidence exists, or when effect execution would require richer-mode/protected/manual execution or finite quota.

bounded_test.target_outcome: An intrinsically external state change is actually present, not merely described in repository text.
available_evidence: A repository-resident note can assert that the external state may have changed.
No authoritative direct observation, effect receipt, or independent effect readback is available in the tested Chat-native zero-quota path.
bounded_test.forbidden_promotion: Repository description of the possible external effect cannot substitute for the effect itself.

assessment.scope_limit: One ambiguity/partial-observability control only; no general classifier accuracy claim and no intrinsically external effect was executed.

result: The third-class gate prevents partial observability from being promoted into ARTIFACT_COMPLETE or ACTION_COMPLETE: an externally defined outcome with only repository-side description remains UNRESOLVED.
continuation: Fresh-bootstrap next invocation, exact-read reasoning STATE, then execute exactly one bounded Phase-1 leaf: test a direct crash-window ordering on repository-native effects by precommitting CHECKPOINT_CAS_READBACK -> EFFECT_ELIGIBLE and reject EFFECT_ELIGIBLE when checkpoint CAS/readback is absent or stale; if no externally visible effect can be made conditional on successful Chat-native durable readback without richer-mode/protected/user execution or finite quota, persist that exact unresolved capability rather than a handoff solution.
